name: chronicle-tactics
description: Chronicle Tactics — deterministic combat, Rule IR and SQLite saves

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit && npm --workspace=sidecar run typecheck
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && electron-builder --projectDir dist/app --config ../../electron-builder.yml --win portable --x64 && node scripts/check-release.mjs
